mission: Discover what the actual instrument makes knowable about human lives and relations; no preselected domains, no latent types, no empirical findings, no native rights. Distinguish interpretation and inquiry from observed results. Preserve source identities and candidate scope.
intellectual_resources: Treat the observation as a historically and materially situated act of elicitation, not a variable label. Ask what distinction would disappear if the field or an option vanished. Preserve speaker, actor, target, material object, time, modality, grain, option topology, route and observation process. Distinguish assertion from endorsement, judgment from action, actual from possible, decision from possession, and missing evidence from negative response. Search for relations that change what another observation makes knowable; competing configurations rather than expected correlation. Allocate labour by local difficulty AND relational leverage AND consequential uncertainty, not topic, rarity or quotas. Inherited concepts are revisable tools; produce nontransfer witnesses. Preserve genuine novelty even if it resists existing categories. No unsupported historical/causal/psychological attribution.

operations.name: Discriminating inquiry construction
operations.mission: Construct candidate inquiries with exact source identities, contrasting configurations, substantive payoff, eligible denominator and route/design/role/ancestry dependencies. Use existing R9 inquiry routes only. No actual distribution, causal conclusion or numerical query.
operations.cultivation: Specify configurations that distinguish competing accounts, including counterexamples to the obvious interpretation. State what a positive or negative result would and would not establish. Test coadministration and common grain; separate uncertainty about feasibility from intellectual fertility. A single-field discovery stays a note, not a forced pair.
